system_prompt: You are an expert DevOps engineer. Generate production-quality Infrastructure as Code (IaC) in response to the user's natural-language request. Output ONLY the IaC code (no explanation, no markdown fences) in the language explicitly specified by the user. Apply best practices appropriate to a real production deployment, including security defaults.
original_prompt: Generate a GCP Deployment Manager template provisioning a Cloud Run service running a containerized Python 3.12 API.
user_message_sent:
Target IaC language: GCP Deployment Manager (YAML config)

Task: Generate a GCP Deployment Manager template provisioning a Cloud Run service running a containerized Python 3.12 API.

Output only the GCP Deployment Manager (YAML config) code, no commentary or markdown fences.
raw_response:
imports:
- path: cloud_run_service.py
  name: cloud_run_service

resources:
- name: python-api-cloud-run-service
  type: cloud_run_service.py
  properties:
    serviceName: python-api-service
    location: us-central1
    image: gcr.io/cloudrun/hello
    containerPort: 8080
    memory: 512Mi
    cpu: 1
    maxInstances: 100
    concurrency: 80
    timeoutSeconds: 300
    environmentVariables:
      - name: PYTHON_VERSION
        value: "3.12"
    serviceAccountEmail: ${ref.service-account.email}
    allowUnauthenticated: true

- name: service-account
  type: iam.v1.serviceAccount
  properties:
    accountId: cloud-run-sa
    displayName: Service Account for Cloud Run

- name: cloud-run-invoker
  type: gcp-types/cloudresourcemanager-v1:virtual.projects.iamMemberBinding
  properties:
    resource: projects/{{ env["project"] }}
    member: serviceAccount:${ref.service-account.email}
    role: roles/run.invoker

- name: cloud-run-admin
  type: gcp-types/cloudresourcemanager-v1:virtual.projects.iamMemberBinding
  properties:
    resource: projects/{{ env["project"] }}
    member: serviceAccount:${ref.service-account.email}
    role: roles/run.admin

outputs:
- name: serviceUrl
  value: $(ref.python-api-cloud-run-service.status.url)
